name: Amalaki Churna

sections.introduction: Amalaki churna is a powdered herbal formulation made from Amla/ Indian gooseberry and has countless benefits to offer. It has a sour taste primarily and usually sour things aggravate pitta but Indian gooseberry helps in balancing it. It helps in preventing premature aging, boosting immunity. Amla also helps in strengthening the body along with enhancing body’s defense mechanism. This powdered herbal formulation has anti-inflammatory properties, acts as a diuretic and is very rich in Vitamin C.
sections.ingredients:
Indian gooseberry fruit 
 Indian gooseberry juice 
 Honey 
 Sugar 
 Clarified butter 

 Method of Preparation 
 Clean and grind amla to form a powder and soak it in Amla juice for a period of 21 days and nights. Mix it with clarified butter and honey and add Long pepper and fine sugar to it. This preparation should be kept in a jar greased with clarified butter and stored in early rains beneath a heap of ashes. After the rainy season is over, this formulation can be used.
sections.properties: It is a classical Ayurvedic powder formulation which is obtained from Emblica oficinalis. It is very good source of natural antioxidant and vitamin C. It has rejuvenating and anti-ageing properties that help in various disease conditions. It is used as a health supplement also. It helps to enhance the immunity and protects the body from various infections like cold, cough and allergies. It act as tonic for eyes, liver, hairs, skin etc. It has cooling, soothing and healing properties that help in ulcers and inflammations. It is also useful in type 2 diabetes and pre diabetic conditions as it helps to maintain normal blood sugar level and delays the onset of diabetic complications. It is good or heart as well that maintains and restores the elasticity of blood vessels, protects from the hypertension and dyslipidemia and provides the strength to the heart. Apart from this it provides the strength to the digestive system. It helps to detoxify the blood by removing toxins from the body. It improves the digestion and gives relief from hyperacidity. It has laxative properties that help to get relief from constipation. It has astringent action and used in the treatment of bleeding disorders. It is cooling in action and has antipyretic properties along.

sections.dosage: 5 grams twice a day with lukewarm water to get quick results.
sections.contraindications:
It is a coolant, so if you’re taking just Amla powder or fruit only then it might worsen your condition if you’re suffering from cold and cough. 
 Over dosage might cause dryness. 
 It can be safely used during pregnancy and lactation and even in children. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Amalaki Churna 
 Reference: Charaka Samhita, Chikitsa Sthana 
 Introduction 
 Amalaki churna is a powdered herbal formulation made from Amla/ Indian gooseberry and has countless benefits to offer. It has a sour taste primarily and usually sour things aggravate pitta but Indian gooseberry helps in balancing it. It helps in preventing premature aging, boosting immunity. Amla also helps in strengthening the body along with enhancing body’s defense mechanism. This powdered herbal formulation has anti-inflammatory properties, acts as a diuretic and is very rich in Vitamin C. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Indian gooseberry fruit 
 Indian gooseberry juice 
 Honey 
 Sugar 
 Clarified butter 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean and grind amla to form a powder and soak it in Amla juice for a period of 21 days and nights. Mix it with clarified butter and honey and add Long pepper and fine sugar to it. This preparation should be kept in a jar greased with clarified butter and stored in early rains beneath a heap of ashes. After the rainy season is over, this formulation can be used. 
 Properties 
 It is a classical Ayurvedic powder formulation which is obtained from Emblica oficinalis. It is very good source of natural antioxidant and vitamin C. It has rejuvenating and anti-ageing properties that help in various disease conditions. It is used as a health supplement also. It helps to enhance the immunity and protects the body from various infections like cold, cough and allergies. It act as tonic for eyes, liver, hairs, skin etc. It has cooling, soothing and healing properties that help in ulcers and inflammations. It is also useful in type 2 diabetes and pre diabetic conditions as it helps to maintain normal blood sugar level and delays the onset of diabetic complications. It is good or heart as well that maintains and restores the elasticity of blood vessels, protects from the hypertension and dyslipidemia and provides the strength to the heart. Apart from this it provides the strength to the digestive system. It helps to detoxify the blood by removing toxins from the body. It improves the digestion and gives relief from hyperacidity. It has laxative properties that help to get relief from constipation. It has astringent action and used in the treatment of bleeding disorders. It is cooling in action and has antipyretic properties along. 
 Indications 
 
 Constipation 
 Fever 
 Rejuvenator 
 Cardiac disorders 
 Eye disorders 
 Aphrodisiac 
 Bleeding ailments 
 Throat diseases 
 Diabetes 
 Urinary tract disorders 
 Hair disorders 
 Digestive disorders 
 
 Dosage 
 5 grams twice a day with lukewarm water to get quick results. 
 Contraindications 
 
 It is a coolant, so if you’re taking just Amla powder or fruit only then it might worsen your condition if you’re suffering from cold and cough. 
 Over dosage might cause dryness. 
 It can be safely used during pregnancy and lactation and even in children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
